designationHistory.indexText: Our History Established in 1965 as part of the Willamette Valley NWR Complex, the Baskett Slough National Wildlife Refuge’s primary management goal is to provide wintering habitat for dusky Canada geese.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
